communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Incumbent Status on RC petitions
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Form 502 has a field for "Name of Recognized or Certified Bargaining Agent" If this data is available in the NxGen system or other other electronic system, I request the data showing the case number associated with the petition and the value of this field.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Forest Gregg

title: Initial-contract (CBM) cases and their outcomes, October 1999 to present

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Initial-contract (CBM) cases and their outcomes, October 1999 to present
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Please include all cases with N-Category "Initial Contract" (Case Type CBM) opened or received from October 1, 1999 through the date the search is run, whatever the case's status or reason for closing. That means cases closed with "Agreement Reached" and also, for example:

- "Parties Failed to Respond"
- "Case Cancelled"
- "Question re: Representation"
- "Employees Included In/Folded Into Existing Unit"
- "Facility Closed"
- "Other"
- cases with no reason for closing recorded
- cases still open

My earlier request FOIA-2022-00042 was fulfilled with only cases closed as "Agreement Reached".

For this request I am asking that cases which did not reach agreement can be counted.

Fields. For each case, please provide the following, where they exist. Field names are from the extract produced for FOIA-2022-00042:
1. The FMCS case number or other unique case identifier
2. Received Date; Initiated Date; the date the case was closed
3. Case Type; N-Case Type; N-Category; N-Case Source (for example F-7 from Union, F-7 from Organization, NLRB, FLRA)
4. N-Date Submitted, and any identifier linking the case to its F-7 notice
5. The NLRB case number (for example 13-RC-123456), or the certification date, for cases opened from NLRB certifications
6. Basis for Closing (Case Statistics)
7. Contract Agreement Date
8. Employer; Union; Union Local; bargaining unit size (BU)
9. The employer's location and the affected or bargaining-unit location (city, state, ZIP code)
10. The industry code (NAICS), if recorded
11. Whether a mediator held joint or separate meetings, and the number and dates of those meetings, if recorded

Personal information. To make processing easier, you may leave out the names, telephone numbers and email addresses of individual employer and union contacts. I do not need them. Please do not leave out the employer or union names.

Older records. If cases from before a particular year are in a legacy system, or have fewer fields, please provide whatever is available for those years, and tell me which fields or years are missing rather than withholding the rest.

Format. I would like the records as a spreadsheet or delimited text file (.xlsx or .csv), one row per case, in the form the system exports. If producing all years would take much longer, please send each portion as it becomes ready, starting with the most recent years.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Forest Gregg

title: : Henderson PD case 23-15229: search warrant & arrest bodycam, 911 call

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Nevada Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the Nevada Public Records Act (NRS Chapter 239), I request copies of the following records for Henderson Police Department case 23-15229:

1. Body-worn camera video from all officers present at the execution of the search warrant at the residence of Devyn Michaels on or about the evening of August 7, 2023.
2. Body-worn camera video of the arrest of Devyn Michaels on or about August 15, 2023.
3. The audio recording of the 911 call(s) reporting the death on August 7, 2023, and the associated CAD/incident log.
4. Body-worn camera video from the initial response on August 7, 2023, limited to the officers' arrival and contact with the reporting party outside the residence. Footage depicting the decedent is not requested and may be excluded.

Electronic copies are preferred. Please release the records in segregable form with only the redactions the law requires, and cite the specific statutory basis for any withholding.

This request is made for a non-commercial documentary and public-interest reporting purpose; I ask for a waiver or reduction of fees. If fees will exceed $50, please send an estimate before processing.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jordan Bradley
